grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, sugar, eggs, ground almonds, baking powder, pears, almonds, ginger and lemon are all ordinary home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line, and 200g of ground almonds is an everyday baking purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: A square dish, bowl and wooden spoon are enough, and creaming butter and sugar is a beginner's technique.

works.reason: The ratio of 100g butter, 80g sugar, 3 eggs and 200g ground almonds makes a sound frangipane-style sponge for a 20cm dish, and 30 to 35 minutes at 180°C is right for twelve squares.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers creaming, zesting, slicing two pears and chopping a few almonds, and the 35-minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the ginger and lemon zest, is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from baking paper.

seasonal_feel.reason: Pears are at their best in late October, and they top the whole traybake rather than acting as a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: A gluten-free almond and egg traybake with fresh pear and modest sugar makes a satisfying afternoon snack a family would bake again.
